title: The cycle script ignores an unknown argument silently
what: The cycle script ignores an unknown argument silently
why: Measured 27 Oct: the front resumed the change cycle (plugins/delegate/workflows/cycle.js) with `gate_fixes: 2` at the top level of args instead of under `settings`; the script ignored the key without a word, replayed every stage from cache in 8 ms and stopped at the same red gate, so one run was wasted and the cause was found only by reading the script. Principle 10: a refusal names the next step.
failing_case: Workflow with cycle.js and args {base, relay, scratch, items, gate_fixes: 2} runs as if gate_fixes were 1, with no message.
pass_cases: An unknown top-level key stops the run in one line before any agent starts, naming the key and where it belongs (for a known setting: 'gate_fixes goes under settings').
Known keys and settings run as today.
tests/test_cycle_workflow.py covers the refusal and fails with the check disabled.
